# Houston Shoulder & Elbow

> > Fellowship-trained orthopedic surgeon Dr. James Gregory specializing in shoulder and elbow surgery at Texas Medical Center in Houston.

Dr. James Gregory practices at UTHealth Houston's McGovern Medical School, offering advanced surgical and non-operative treatments for shoulder and elbow conditions including rotator cuff tears, arthritis, labrum injuries, and sports-related injuries. The practice combines NIH-funded research with clinical excellence at Memorial Hermann in the Texas Medical Center.

## Key Topics

- Shoulder Surgery

## Elbow Conditions & Treatment

- [Elbow Surgery in Houston | Texas Medical Center | James Gregory MD](https://houstonshoulderelbow.com/elbow): Specialized elbow surgery for biceps tears, arthritis, and injuries
- [Elbow Treatment Options in Houston | James Gregory MD](https://houstonshoulderelbow.com/elbow/treatment-options): Non-operative and surgical elbow treatment options in Houston
- [UCL Injury in Houston | Texas Medical Center | James Gregory MD](https://houstonshoulderelbow.com/elbow/ulnar-collateral-ligament-injury): UCL injury and Tommy John surgery for throwers and athletes in Houston
- [Cubital Tunnel Syndrome in Houston | James Gregory MD](https://houstonshoulderelbow.com/elbow/cubital-tunnel-syndrome): Cubital tunnel syndrome and ulnar nerve compression treatment in Houston
- [Elbow Stiffness in Houston | James Gregory MD | Texas Medical Center](https://houstonshoulderelbow.com/elbow/elbow-stiffness): Elbow stiffness treatment including therapy and arthroscopic surgery
- [Olecranon Bursitis in Houston | James Gregory MD | Texas Medical Center](https://houstonshoulderelbow.com/elbow/olecranon-bursitis): Olecranon bursitis treatment including injections and bursa removal
